newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Antartica IBBC downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Antartica IBBC downgraded.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it is downgrading its recommendation for Brazilian brewery Antartica IBBC, also known as Antartica Paulista, to hold from buy.
-- The brokerage said the firm's shares are undervalued and its multiples are low but it recommends holding the stock due to short-term market pressures that have been hurting the firm.
-- Fator said the effects of Antartica Paulista's restructuring program and the recovery in performance will become apparent only in the medium or long-term.
-- Antartica Paulista is the holding company for the Antartica group, putting it at a disadvantage both to the market and other group members, it said.

-- Last year, Antartica controlled 24 listed and unlisted companies but a partnership with U.S.-based Anheuser Busch led to the creation of Antartica Emprendimentos e Participacoes (ANEP) and a slightly less complicated holding structure, is said.
-- Antartica Paulista holds 95 percent of ANEP while Anheuser Busch owns five percent, with an option to increase that to 29.7 percent.
-- Antartica IBBC's common voting share was flat at 85.00 reais at 1542 local/1742 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
